beats.text: Flickr was a photo site from day one.
beats.note: It began inside a video game. Ludicorp's Game Neverending was a web based multiplayer game, and Flickr emerged from tools built for it.
The History of the Web says Game Neverending was developed at Ludicorp in 2002, with messaging, item trading and photo sharing.

beats.text: The company was running out of cash.
beats.note: The History of the Web reports the team voted to spin out the photo feature by a margin of just one.

beats.context: The margin by which Ludicorp's team chose to spin out photo sharing, according to The History of the Web.

beats.note: Wikipedia gives 10 February 2004. The History of the Web says it was unveiled that month at the O'Reilly Emerging Tech conference.
Wikipedia, Britannica, The History of the Web and Historyofinformation all give March 2005. Wikipedia reports a price between 22 and 25 million dollars.

beats.text: The game was shelved. The side feature became the product.
